limitations: nfl_pbp has no row-level publication/ingestion timestamp
historical schedule score revisions are not available in the current database

reference_pool_scope.kick_table: not filtered: the published kick rates include overtime kicks
reference_pool_scope.safety_kick_table: observed 2022-2025 regular-season safety free kicks, usable rows only

execution_verification.note: A layer is only reported executed when its instrumented decision path ran. State-conditional layers can have zero applications in a small sample; that remains visible and does not count as a silent fallback.

player_outcome_model.conditioning: event type plus joint yards-bin and touchdown label; result sampled before state transition
player_outcome_model.source: nflverse nfl_pbp pass, rush, sack, completion and interception fields; participant keys are GSIS ids
player_outcome_model.transfer_rule: outcome observations are retained by stable player id; QB decision tendencies are separately keyed by team and QB
player_outcome_model.yardage_fallback: a missing role-specific player yard field omits that result adjustment; emitted box-score yards use yards_gained when the source field is null

player_share_distribution.eligibility_rule: a rostered player listed Out or Doubtful on the frozen injury report is not eligible; Questionable and players with no report stay eligible; position-conditioned shares re-normalise within the selected eligible group

qb_decision_model.qb_run_role_definition: primary-QB rush_attempt rows with play_type=run, excluding explicit scrambles, dropbacks, penalties and two-point attempts; qb_kneel rows are excluded by play_type. The residual can include QB sneaks because the source does not identify them separately.
qb_decision_model.qb_run_role_exposure: team run plays in games where the QB had the most recorded dropbacks; ties between primary passers are excluded
qb_decision_model.qb_run_role_style: player-versus-team log-odds adjustment to the team QB run-role prior, with 20-opportunity shrinkage

qb_sneak_classification.reason: the nfl_pbp table used by this fit has no qb_sneak field or play description, so sneaks cannot be separated in this model input

qb_decision_model.scramble_definition: qb_scramble among nflverse qb_dropback rows; scrambler identity uses rusher_player_id joined by GSIS id when its canonical position is QB
qb_decision_model.source: nfl_pbp qb_dropback, qb_scramble, pass_attempt, rush_attempt, penalty, two_point_attempt and play_type; canonical QB, rusher and receiver positions joined by GSIS id
qb_decision_model.transfer_rule: QB decision histories remain keyed by team and passer; a new team uses its team and league priors

qb_run_role_style.rule: player-versus-team historical log-odds adjustment to the QB run-role share

playcall_layer.score_clock_fallback_policy: historical_down_distance_field_cell_rate; independent point and streak layers remain separately switchable

season_blend.rule: w = N0 / (N0 + g); counts blended as (h + s) * (w * H/h + (1 - w) * S/s)

unchanged.current_streak_context: already the current season: each team's streak entering the game
unchanged.defensive_coverage_outcomes: coverage comes from the same participation release, so the coverage priors stay historical
unchanged.formation_personnel_outcomes: no current-season participation release (nflverse pbp_participation ends at 2025 in the 2026-10-27 backfill), so the formation and personnel priors stay historical
unchanged.outcome_pool_and_kicks: the drawn outcome rows, kick tables and participant lookups stay the historical pool; the selected team event or joint-transition table can adapt from cutoff-safe current-season plays

source_row_filters.kick_table: not filtered: the published kick rates include overtime kicks
source_row_filters.safety_kick_table: observed 2022-2025 regular-season safety free kicks, usable rows only

player_projections.note: Means include zero production for nonparticipating games. Player results are role allocations from sampled historical plays, not player-specific performance projections.

receiver_position_usage.source: nfl_pbp player GSIS ID joined to players.nfl_gsis_id; position groups from canonical NFL identity

runner_position_usage.source: nfl_pbp player GSIS ID joined to players.nfl_gsis_id; position groups from canonical NFL identity

model_reference.play_pool: nfl_pbp seasons 2022-2025 only; no 2026 outcome is in the pool

pool_scope.kick_table: not filtered: the published kick rates include overtime kicks
pool_scope.safety_kick_table: observed 2022-2025 regular-season safety free kicks, usable rows only

simulation.regulation_score_policy: all runs whose simulation reached the regulation end, including ties and guarded regulation-end outcomes; descriptive, not validated finals

rng_protocol.stream_key: stream_root_sha256 (code and artifact hashes are provenance only)

simulation.seed_rule: one deterministic game per consecutive non-negative integer seed
simulation.valid_score_policy: only valid_full_game=true, complete_game=true, untied outcomes; all other seeds remain in outcomes and coverage counts

configuration.overlap_rule: category A controls target-role label when available; playbook replaces C/D/E where supported

configuration.eligibility_rule: a rostered player listed Out or Doubtful on the frozen injury report is not eligible; Questionable and players with no report stay eligible; position-conditioned shares re-normalise within the selected eligible group

configuration.yardline_rule: exact yardline inside the 20 when source rows exist

configuration.precedence: replaces decision labels for C/D/E when the source cell has a playbook prior

configuration.conditioning: event type plus joint yards-bin and touchdown label; result sampled before state transition
configuration.source: nflverse nfl_pbp pass, rush, sack, completion and interception fields; participant keys are GSIS ids
configuration.transfer_rule: outcome observations are retained by stable player id; QB decision tendencies are separately keyed by team and QB
configuration.yardage_fallback: a missing role-specific player yard field omits that result adjustment; emitted box-score yards use yards_gained when the source field is null

configuration.qb_run_role_definition: primary-QB rush_attempt rows with play_type=run, excluding explicit scrambles, dropbacks, penalties and two-point attempts; qb_kneel rows are excluded by play_type. The residual can include QB sneaks because the source does not identify them separately.
configuration.qb_run_role_exposure: team run plays in games where the QB had the most recorded dropbacks; ties between primary passers are excluded
configuration.qb_run_role_style: player-versus-team log-odds adjustment to the team QB run-role prior, with 20-opportunity shrinkage

qb_sneak_classification.reason: the nfl_pbp table used by this fit has no qb_sneak field or play description, so sneaks cannot be separated in this model input

configuration.scramble_definition: qb_scramble among nflverse qb_dropback rows; scrambler identity uses rusher_player_id joined by GSIS id when its canonical position is QB
configuration.source: nfl_pbp qb_dropback, qb_scramble, pass_attempt, rush_attempt, penalty, two_point_attempt and play_type; canonical QB, rusher and receiver positions joined by GSIS id
configuration.transfer_rule: QB decision histories remain keyed by team and passer; a new team uses its team and league priors

configuration.rule: player-versus-team historical log-odds adjustment to the QB run-role share

configuration.overlap_rule: category A is sampled from the normalized geometric mean of team target-role and decision priors, renormalized to frozen eligible roles

field_semantics.drive_window_seconds: Elapsed time from each drive start state to its end state; separately reported from summed per-play possession clock.
field_semantics.fourth_down_attempts: Scrimmage plays that began on fourth down; punts and field-goal attempts are excluded from go-for-it attempts.
field_semantics.lineup_player_snaps: Modeled RB/FB/WR/TE lineup appearances only; QB and linemen excluded and production chosen independently.
field_semantics.observed_overtime_touchdowns: Offensive touchdowns on observed overtime drives without play or player attribution.
field_semantics.offensive_success_rate: Down-based success: at least 40% of yards-to-go on first down, 60% on second, chains on third/fourth; touchdowns count as successful plays.
field_semantics.other_score_points: Non-touchdown, non-safety score-ledger points, including field goals.
field_semantics.possession_seconds: Sum of recorded per-play game-clock intervals while this team had possession; reconciled separately with drive windows and kickoff clock time.
field_semantics.red_zone_field_goals: Made field goals; alias of red_zone_field_goals_made.
field_semantics.snaps: Starting QB: team scrimmage plays. RB, FB, WR, TE: lineup-model count. Null for linemen and defenders, which are not modeled.
field_semantics.starter: Frozen depth-chart role, not evidence of playing time.
field_semantics.targets: Assigned receivers on pass attempts; throwaways and spikes are not modeled, so targets generally equal attempts.
field_semantics.third_down_attempts: Scrimmage plays that began on third down; conversions require a same-possession transition to a new first down.
field_semantics.try_points: Touchdown drive ledger points above six, not a count of try attempts.

boxscore.player_note: Participants are selected from the frozen pregame roster before the outcome. qb, receiver, rusher outcome rows are reweighted by cutoff-safe player distributions before the game-state transition. Box-score passing, receiving and rushing yards use their corresponding nflverse fields when present; the state transition uses yards_gained. This is a research projection layer; historical source outcomes and the current model do not establish calibrated forecasts.

quarter_by_quarter.player_stats_scope: players_with_period_activity; omitted roster players have zero period stats

realism.lineup_semantics: player_snaps counts modeled RB/FB/WR/TE lineup appearances only, not full player snaps; production is selected independently.
